notes.title: Pure puzzles!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

《Skyeisle Cube》 has just rolled out its new version (0.2), bringing new features and support for handheld consoles. Thank you for your continued support. Below are the main updates in this version:

[b][New Features][/b]

[list]
[*]Simplified Mode: Players can now enable the Simplified Mode in the settings interface to hide models in the game, making the gameplay more intuitive and refreshing, and enhancing overall smoothness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292095/fa5e88d1cdb8e29bbfa54df598b6c6b4b45348ee.png[/img]
[*]Steam Deck Adaptation: We have tested the game, and now Island Cube can be played on Steam Deck at any power consumption, allowing you to enjoy island puzzles on your handheld device!

[u]Hold L2 and move the joystick to rotate the view
Press R2 for a single click, hold R2 and slide to multi-select[/u]
[/list]
[b]Next month, we will update a new chapter containing 40 puzzles![/b]

[b]Finally, thank you all for your enthusiastic feedback and support. We will continue to work hard to optimize and update the game, bringing you more interesting content. Wishing everyone a pleasant time on the island!
[/b]
